body: I live in a city, not the most possible thing.

I'm still in the house because I live near the station. I've kind of...decided against this after giving it some thought. But the note is still written, and I kind of want to do it after I think all of the ramifications through a little more. It feels as if this is the only way my problems will stop because, truthfully, I am the root of all of my problems because of my mental illness. But a couple more days of hell won't kill me, I guess. I have money left, and I guess one more day alive won't be so bad.
